K-ESS3-3.subject: earth
K-ESS3-3.text: Communicate solutions that will reduce the impact of humans on the land, water, air, and/or other living things in the local environment.

4-ESS3-2.subject: earth
4-ESS3-2.text: Generate and compare multiple solutions to reduce the impacts of natural Earth processes on humans.

5-ESS3-1.subject: earth
5-ESS3-1.text: Obtain and combine information about ways individual communities use science ideas to protect the Earth's resources and environment.

MS-ESS1-3.subject: space
MS-ESS1-3.text: Analyze and interpret data to determine scale properties of objects in the solar system.

MS-ESS3-2.subject: earth
MS-ESS3-2.text: Analyze and interpret data on natural hazards to forecast future catastrophic events and inform the development of technologies to mitigate their effects.

MS-ESS3-3.subject: earth
MS-ESS3-3.text: Apply scientific principles to design a method for monitoring and minimizing a human impact on the environment.

MS-LS2-5.subject: life
MS-LS2-5.text: Evaluate competing design solutions for maintaining biodiversity and ecosystem services.

HS-ESS1-4.subject: space
HS-ESS1-4.text: Use mathematical or computational representations to predict the motion of orbiting objects in the solar system.

HS-ESS3-4.subject: earth
HS-ESS3-4.text: Evaluate or refine a technological solution that reduces impacts of human activities on natural systems.

CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.RI.5.9.subject: literacy
CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.RI.5.9.text: Integrate information from several texts on the same topic in order to write or speak about the subject knowledgeably.

CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.RST.6-8.1.subject: literacy
CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.RST.6-8.1.text: Cite specific textual evidence to support analysis of science and technical texts.
